about: The owner's cue notes for Lost in the Void. 'near' is the owner's rough time in seconds; the analysis snaps each cue to the nearest bar. Section names are keyed by the bar each section starts on, once the analysis has found them.

cues.name: reach
cues.note: The song turns mellow: the astronaut reaches up in slow motion; the Claude mascot is revealed bit by bit, intercut with low flybys over the message's human figure.

cues.name: touch
cues.note: The beat kicks back in as the astronaut and the mascot touch hands; from here the mascot rides the board's tip, pointing forward.
